To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The presence or absence of control structures in a hypothesis space is a key factor in the learnability of the space.

the presence of certain control structures is essential to maintain full learnability power; and that the presence of a projection control structure in the hypothesis space is sufficient for full learnability power.

the presence of certain control structures need not help and the absence of certain control structure need not hinder learning, but the presence of a certain projection control structure is essential for full learning power.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of control structures in learning.
the influence of control structures on learnability.
the question of whether the presence of certain control structures is necessary for learning power, and if so, which ones.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, with the exception of proj, the presence or absence in a hypothesis space of any control structure is of no consequence to learning power.
the presence of proj in a hypothesis space need not help learning and its absence need not hinder it.
The presence in the hypothesis space of any control structure that is not proj, or any control structure that has no instance in V, is essential to maintain full learnability power.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of control structures, in general, is essential to learning power, but the absence of proj is not.

the learning power of a class of functions is not affected by the presence or absence in the hypothesis space of any particular denotational control structure, but is affected by the presence of a certain projection control structure.
, in general, control structures in hypothesis spaces are neither necessary nor sufficient for learning, but they can influence the learning power.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the learning power of a learning class can be preserved by the presence in the underlying hypothesis space of only a small number of control structures.
, in a learnability context, the presence or absence in a hypothesis space of certain control structures can have a significant impact on the learning power of the space.
the presence or absence in V of certain control structures, in particular proj, can be crucial to learning.
